About Us: 







     
 The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe. 
   
 Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center seeks Infrastructure Engineer in Lyndhurst, NJ to develop and lead project initiatives to optimize resources and make efficient use of available technologies. Develop systems architecture for all systems, operating systems, server technologies, networking, security, and monitor functional areas. Oversee all aspects of system design, configuration, security, and efficient use of IT resources. Direct hardware/software installations and upgrades on multiple platforms, ensuring service requests are being fulfilled according to project plans and SLAs. Meet with IS Project Managers and key users across the institution to gather their project needs and create a project list. Evaluate, implement, and enhance High Availability software/hardware, ensuring maximum uptime and recoverability from outages to critical clinical, financial, and business systems. Lead the evaluation and introduction of state of the art technologies and tools. Support IT engineering efforts on projects and activities with programmers, administrators, analysts, engineers, security specialists, storage/EBR specialists, and ITIL specialists. Part time telecommuting permitted. EEO/VETS/ADA.
  
 REQUIREMENTS: 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a closely related field and 5 years of experience in the position offered or related role. Requires 5 years of experience in all of the following: Linux operating systems administration and troubleshooting (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS); server builds, patching, and configuration management; system monitoring and performance tuning; infrastructure security and best practices; writing automation scripts (Bash, Python, or similar); and supporting operations across physical and virtual environments. Requires 3 years of experience participating in disaster recovery exercises and providing on call support; and working with the following tools and technologies: VMware vSphere, Redhat Cluster, Ansible, Puppet, AWS.
  
 SALARY:                  $144,477 - $225,100/year
   
 LOCATION:             1050 Wall Street West (NJDC), Lyndhurst, NJ 07071
  
 Apply for the Infrastructure Engineer position at https://careers.mskcc.org .
   
Pay Range: $136,400.00 - $225,100.00   
FSLA Status: Exempt   
 Closing : 
 
 At MSK, we believe in fair, competitive pay that reflects your job, experience, and skills.
 
 MSK is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to diversity and inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran status or any other factor which cannot lawfully be used as a basis for an employment decision.   
 
 Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.
